arguments.command: PYTHONPATH=host:consumer python -m pytest host/tests/test_dictutils.py host/tests/test_funcutils*.py host/tests/test_setutils.py consumer/glom/test -q

PYTHONPATH=host:consumer python - <<'PY'
from boltons.dictutils import OneToOne, OrderedMultiDict, FastIterOrderedMultiDict
from boltons.iterutils import unique
import random
x=OneToOne([('a', 1), ('b', 1), ('c', 2)])
assert x == {'b':1, 'c':2} and x.inv == {1:'b', 2:'c'}
x.update(iter([('d', 2), ('e',3)]))
assert x == {'b':1,'d':2,'e':3} and x.inv.inv is x
random.seed(0)
for t in range(100):
    pairs=[(random.randrange(6),i) for i in range(30)]
    a=OrderedMultiDict(pairs); b=FastIterOrderedMultiDict(pairs)
    assert list(b)==unique(k for k,v in pairs), (pairs,list(b))
    assert b.items(multi=True)==a.items(multi=True)
    assert list(reversed(b))==list(reversed(a))
    for k in unique(k for k,v in pairs):
        a.popall(k); b.popall(k)
        assert list(b)==list(a)
print('duplicate-input smoke tests passed')
PY
